definitions.text: slutte å spille eller gi opp et kortspill fordi en ikke vil eller kan spille kortene en har
definitions.translation: stop playing or give up a card game because one does not want to or cannot play the cards one has (lit. to throw the cards)

definitions.text: gi opp (en sak, et standpunkt eller lignende)
definitions.translation: give up (a cause, a position, or the like)

examples.no: hun kastet kortene da hun tapte valget
examples.en: she gave up when she lost the election
